description: Shows open GitHub issues of each project's repository in the Sidebar, using the local gh CLI.
author: C0reca

commands.title: List open issues
commands.description: Lists open issues for one project (projectId) or for every project, grouped by repository. Pass refresh: true to bypass the 60 s cache.

commands.title: Read project issues
commands.description: Sidebar items for one project's open issues.

commands.title: Refresh issues
commands.description: Clears the cache for a project's repository and reads its open issues again.

commands.title: Assign issue to agent
commands.description: Creates a task for a trusted issue (idempotent per issue) and launches a Claude Code agent on it. Refuses issues whose author is not trusted.

commands.title: Assign issue (untrusted author)
commands.description: Human-only Sidebar action: assigns an issue whose author is not trusted. Needs host context, so it cannot run from the CLI.

preferences.title: Trusted issue authors
preferences.description: Extra authors whose issues may be assigned, one line per repository: owner/repo: alice, bob  or  *: alice. Adds to the defaults (repository owner, C0reca, collaborators with write access).

preferences.title: Auto-approve repositories
preferences.description: Comma or newline separated owner/repo list. Agents launched for these repositories run with full access and no permission prompts.
